title: Review explicit any
why: The any type disables static checking for the value and can spread unchecked assumptions through callers.
suggestion: Use a concrete type or unknown with an explicit narrowing check.
limitations: Detects explicit any type tokens after masking comments and literals; similarly prefixed type names are not any. Repeated occurrences are grouped per file.

Declaration files and dynamic API boundaries are not exempt: compatibility signatures, narrowing predicates and runtime-validated values can intentionally use any. Advice does not prove unknown is a source-compatible replacement.

Explicit Biome noExplicitAny and Deno lint.rules include/exclude policy is honored at the nearest configured directory; Deno takes precedence over Biome at the same directory. Deno file and next balanced-node no-explicit-any directives are honored.
Deno directive attachment is lexical, not an AST span; unusual unbraced multiline declarations and configuration extends, tags, and file overrides are not resolved.
